description: API Temps Réel TISSEO - Real Time TISSEO API is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Tisséo. API version: 2.1 L'API Tisséo permet d'interroger les données dynamiquement. Elle offre les services suivants: stopsschedules: horaires à un ou plusieurs arrêts en temps réel journeys: calcul d’itinéraire places: recherche de lieux lines: liste des lignes (et de leurs perturbations) rollingstocks: liste les modes de transport disponibles sur le réseau stopareas: liste des zones d’arrêts ... Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are Bus, Métro, Tramway, Tisséo, Horaires, Téléphérique. The portal shows 1 records. The portal shows 2023-04-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
